  FROM public.order_items
  WHERE status <> 'Cancelled'
    AND created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
  GROUP BY user_id, order_id
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT user_id, order_date,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY order_date) AS rn
  FROM orders
),
pivot AS (
  SELECT user_id,
         MAX(CASE WHEN rn=1 THEN order_date END) AS first_order,
         MAX(CASE WHEN rn=2 THEN order_date END) AS second_order
  FROM ranked
  WHERE rn <= 2
  GROUP BY user_id
  HAVING COUNT(*) = 2
)
SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (second_order - first_order))/86400.0) AS p95_days
FROM pivot
